d:
B Praak and Jaani, the duo that never misses, now in stunning 8K Rabba Ve is the soul-stirring song from the Punjabi film High End Yaariyan, with B Praak’s powerful voice and music and Jaani’s heartfelt lyrics.
High End Yaariyan follows three friends, played by Jassie Gill, Ranjit Bawa and Ninja, living abroad, and how their friendship grows and is tested as they struggle far from home. Rabba Ve captures all the emotion of that journey, and every frame is sharper than ever
